screen.neoorigins.mob_creator: Ko te Kaihanga o te Pūtake o te Rōpū
gui.neoorigins.creator.stub: %s ripa  i whakatinanahia i te wāhanga 2.1 i muri mai
origins.neoorigins.human.name: Te tangata
origins.neoorigins.human.description: He tangata noa iho, kāore he mana motuhake engari he āheinga whānui.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Ko te Merling
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: He tangata wai i whānau mai i te moana tuwhera  e manawa ana i te wai, ā, he ngāwari te kaukau, engari he puhoi, ā, ka maroke i runga i te whenua maroke.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: He manu
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: He kaikawe ahuareka e heke puhoi ana, e kore e wehi i te tiketike, ā, e mātakitaki ana i te ao i runga ake.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Te whakaohooho
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: I whānau mai i ngā ahi o raro  i whakawātea i roto i te whanariki, i whakahoutia i roto i te ao pōuri, engari i mate i te wai me te ua.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: He tohunga rererangi  e rere ana i roto i te rangi, kaore i pa ki nga kaha kinetic, engari he ngoikore te anga me te kore e kaha ki te mau i te whakangungu taumaha.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Ko te Enderian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: I whānau mai i ngā moutere o waho o te Whakamutunga  e whakawhitiwhiti ana i a ia e hiahia ana, e karo ana i ngā pupuhi ki roto i te kore, ā, e haere ana e kore e kitea e ngā tangata o waho.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Ko te pungawerewere
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Ko ngā iwi ngārara e piki ana i tētahi pakitara, e pupuhi ana i ngā kupenga ki ngā hoariri, ā, e patu ana i ngā ngārara  e ōrite ana ki ngā ngārara e waru ngā waewae o te ao.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Ko Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: He kākahu pēnei i te kākahu  e whakakahore ana i ngā whiu, e hoki ana ki roto i tētahi kōhua ina whakairihia, ā, ka whakarewahia e ia ngā hoariri ki te rangi me te pupuhi. He puhoi, engari he pūmau.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Ko te Phantom
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: He mea ātaahua  e rere ana i te pō i runga i ngā parirau elytra, e hopu ana i te kaha mai i ngā patu, engari ka tahuna e te rā, ā, kāore e taea te okioki.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: E ora tonu ana i raro i te wai, ā, e kite mārama ana i roto i te wai, kāore he pōhēhē.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: He tere ake te nekehanga i a ia e kaukau ana.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: E kite mārama ana i ngā hohonu pōuri. Whakawhiti ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.merling_land_slowdown.d: E 10% te puhoi o te nekehanga i runga i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Ka maroke
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Ka heke iho te hau i a koe i waho o te wai: ka roa rawa te mata, ka ngenge koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te Waipū Waipū, ko tētahi aratohu kaha e tata ana rānei e pupuri ana i a ia.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Kāore e pāngia e te hinga  Ka mau ngā parirau ki te hau.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: He Ngāti Ngāti Ngāti Porou
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Ka taea te huri: ka heke haere. Kua whakakorehia i te taunoa. Tuhipoka: ko nga whiu tino nui e hiahiatia ana kia hinga noa, na kia mau ki te crit.
Whakamahia ana he 75% iti iho te pūngao i ngā mahi katoa.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Te Tirohanga Ataahua
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: He pai ake te kite i te pōuri.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Ngā Ngutu Kore
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 ngā ngakau (-2 HP mōrahi), tinana māmā, anga ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Te Hopu o te Feather Hop
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Whakatere-whakatere ki runga me te pupuhi tere o te parirau. Kāore he utu o te hiakai.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: He ārai ki te ahi, ki te awa, ki te magma, ki te tahuna  ka whakautu te ahi i roto i te ahi i waho.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: He tere ake te tere i runga i te whenua kāinga  ka tere ake i te wa e noho ana i raro (kaore he tohu tohu e kitea ana).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Ko ngā ringaringa tahanga e keri ana i te taumata kohatu-pikaha  wahia te kohatu, nga ore, me te raro o te kohatu me te kore taputapu.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: He wera te ahi ā-roto  25% tere ake te heke o te hiakai.
He matū te wai  he 1.5 ngā kino ia hēkona i roto i te wai, i te ua rānei.
Ko ngā kanohi kua whakaritea ki te pōkākā  e kite mārama ana i te pōuri. Whakawhiti ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: He mura ahi
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Tukua he pōro ahi iti ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. E rua ngā pūngao. E whā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.n: Ko te Whakarei i a Elytra
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Ka piki ake te tere i te wā e whakarewahia ana e te elytra.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Te Rerenga Māori
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Whakatere pēnei i te kaiwhakamahi elytra  kāore he taonga e hiahiatia ana. Patohia te peke i a koe e taka ana ki te hora i ō parirau.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: +30% tere rere  ka piko te rangi ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Te hinga o te huruhuru
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.descri: Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: E ārai ana i te kino o te tukinga  rere ki ngā pakitara me te kore he hua.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Ko te anga pakaru
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Ko ngā wheua manu kōaro  e rua ngā ngākau iti rawa.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Kāore e taea te mau i ngā kākahu taumaha
Kāore e taea te whakakakahu i te rino, i te koura, i te taimana, i te netherite rānei  kiri me te mekameka anake. Me noho māmā ngā parirau.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Te whakaeke
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Whakapā atu ki mua i runga i ngā waewae matotoru. E rua te kaha. E whā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Ko te Ground Slam
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Pāwhiritia te whenua ki ngā ringa rino  4 kino me te Slowness II mō te 4 hēkona ki ngā hoariri tata katoa i roto i te radius o te 5-block.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Ka wareware a Endermen ki tō titiro  titiro atu ki a rātau me te kore e whakaoho i tētahi whakaeke.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% te tūponotanga ki te whakawhitiwhiti atu, ki te karo i te kino ina patua e tētahi pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: E rua ngā kino ia hēkona i te whakapā atu ki te wai, ki te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Ender Warp
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Teleport ki te wāhi e titiro ana koe  ki runga ki te 50 poraka. utu 2 pūngao. 3 hēkona cooldown.
Piri ki tētahi mata poutū  pēhi ki te pakitara hei hopu, peke ki te piki, pupuri i te hīki kia mau ki te wāhi.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Ka neke i roto i ngā kupenga kupenga me te kore e whakaroa, ā, ka pakaru tata tonu.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Ka kiia he arthropod  he whiu atu i ngā patu Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.n: Ko te Ringa o te Piko
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Ko ngā whakaeke patu-a-tangata e werohia ana te waipiro  ka mamae ngā whaainga i te Waipiro I mō te 3 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: E maka ana i tētahi kupenga kupenga e tū ana i runga i te pānga, e pā ana ki ngā mea katoa e tau ana ki a ia.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Whakatupato Pūmau I  ka hopu te kōhua i ngā whiu e pakaru ai tētahi tinana ngohengohe.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: He puhoi ake te nekehanga i te tikanga.
Active: tuku i tētahi pupuhi o ngā kōpae whakatere  e rere ana ngā hoariri tata ki runga mō te 3 hēkona. Ka pau i a ia te mana 2 hēkona. 8 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Active: ngaro ki roto i tō anga, ka puta mai anō ki te 12 whanganga ki tawhiti. E 3 te kaha. 10 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: E ārai ana i te ngaru  E pupuri ana tō kōhua i a koe i te wā e hoki mai ana ngā pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Ka āhei te kite mārama i roto i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Ka taea e ia te ora i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Te āhua āhuahira
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Ka kore e kitea, ā, ka rere noa iho.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Nga Parirau Whakaahua
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Whakatere pēnei i te kaiwhakamahi elytra  kāore he taonga e hiahiatia ana. Patohia te peke i a koe e taka ana ki te hora i ō parirau.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Ka piki ake te tere i te wā e rere ana  ka rere kaha ngā paruparu.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Ko te papa marama
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Resistance I i raro i te marama (i te pō anake)  ko te marama e taupoki ana i te āhua ātaahua. Ka tangohia e te marama o te rā te tiaki.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Te Whakangaromanga o te Wairua
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Whakaorangia te 1 HP ia wā ka whakamate koe i tētahi mea ora.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Kaore he taumaha
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Kāore he kino o te hinga  Kāore ngā tinana wairua e tau.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Te wera o te rā
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Ka mura te ahi, ā, ka pāngia e te 1.5 i ia hēkona i te marama o te rā.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: He āhua ngoikore
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 ngā ngākau (-4 HP mōrahi). He māmā te whakakore i te tinana o te kapua.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Te wehi kore moe
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Kāore e taea te moe  ko te pō tō āhuatanga.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Ko te ngeru
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: He tangata ngeru tere me te kitenga o te po, me te tere o te peke  ka eke ki runga i o ratou waewae, ka rere atu i nga wuruhi me nga ocelots, engari ka kino ki te wai me te wera i te kaha tere.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: I te wā katoa ka ū haumaru. Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Ka āhei te kite mārama i te pōuri. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: He āta mahi
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: Ka tere ake te 10% i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Te Hauora o te Ngārara
